items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: Did you ever play with Gene Krupa? ... Yeah.

ctx.x: Were you impressed? Well did you know Krupa early in his career?
No, I didn't know him too well. I heard of him and that he was the greatest drummer around. And I heard of him but he and I were never thrown together. Either they had me or they had him.
